==Purpose of template==
This template is used to flag pages that need updates.

==How to use==
 <nowiki>{{update|description=description}}</nowiki>

==Examples==

===Basic===

 <nowiki>{{update}}</nowiki>

{{update}}

===With description===

 <nowiki>{{update|description=Needs more information.}}</nowiki>

{{update|description=Needs more information.}}
